pull.title: KAFKA-20803: Index batched read state responses once
pull.body:
Follow-up to #22835 for [KAFKA-20803](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-20803).

When many partitions share a `READ_SHARE_GROUP_STATE` batch, `ReadStateHandler` scans the combined response for every handler. Reuse `PartitionResultIndex` to index the response once and look up each handler's result, reducing worst-case demultiplexing from O(N²) to average O(N) per batch while preserving response payloads and error/retry handling.

This RPC was deferred in #22835 because it is less frequent than WRITE. This change targets large batches and trades O(N) temporary map entries for bounded response traversal; it makes no cluster latency or heap benchmark claim. The PR is independent of the other RPC follow-ups.

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

issue_comments.body:
Validation:

- Added `ReadStateHandlerDemultiplexingTest`: mixed topics with overlapping partition numbers, payload/error-message preservation, missing topics/partitions, null/bodyless responses, fresh responses after a retry, and direct completion without a shared index.
- The work-count regression runs with 1, 16, and 256 partitions. On unchanged trunk, the 16/256 cases fail because `results()` is accessed per handler. With this change, `results()` and the topic's partition list are each accessed once, and every response partition key is read exactly once.
- Passed `./gradlew :server-common:spotlessApply :server-common:test --tests '*PersisterStateManagerTest' --tests '*ReadStateHandlerDemultiplexingTest' :server-common:spotlessCheck`, including module Checkstyle and SpotBugs main checks.
- Passed `git diff --check`.

Prepared with Codex assistance.
